name: Kalamera 24' Built-In Wine Refrigerator 46-Bottle Dual Zone,Stainless Steel
description: Wine bottles not included.Do you like both delicious, rich red wines and crisp, light white wines? How can you keep both at just the perfect temperature for chilling? This Kalamera Wine Cooler delivers even cooling at just the right temperature, with a dual zone structure that cools each area to the appropriate chilling temperature. The compressor is silent, so it won't disturb your family or guests, and it has low vibration, so it won't disturb the wine either! It has a 46-bottle capacity, with each bottle cradled in its own space, made of natural beech wood shelving. The entire unit is beautifully crafted in elegant black, with gray glass that filters UV Rays, all set in a stainless steel door and handle. The cooler is lit with soft blue LED lighting, so it displays beautifully wherever you decide to store your wine-in a home bar, entertainment area, or in the kitchen. The unit is only 24" wide, so it fits easily in most areas. The most important thing is that wherever you display it, it will give you perfectly chilled, flavorful wine whenever you want it!Specifications: 46-bottle holding capacityTemperature range: 40-66°F Slide-out beech wood shelvesRubber bushing to absorb vibration and noiseInternal fan evenly circulates air & temperatureETL approvedFashionable flat faced stainless steel handleWarranty: 1 year parts and laborBuilt in under counterDigital temperature controls w/ LED displayPowerful compressor coolingBlue interior LED lightingAuto defrostInput Voltage: 110 V/60 HzWeight: 104.5lbsDimensions: 22.4 x 23.4 x 33 inches Size: W 23.4" / D 22.4" / H 33".
